comments.author: danyel
comments.text:
## Root Cause Analysis

The `urlState.ts` module has all the URL state infrastructure:
- `updateUrl(state, pushHistory)` - updates browser URL via history.pushState/replaceState
- `parseUrlState()` - reads state from URL hash
- `verseToUrlFormat()` - converts verse to URL format
- `debounce()` - for debouncing pan/zoom updates
- `subscribeToHashChange()` - for browser back/forward

But `main.ts` only imports `getCurrentUrl` for the Copy Link button and **never calls `updateUrl`**.

## What needs to be wired up

1. **On state changes, call `updateUrl`:**
   - Overlay changes (`setOverlay()`)
   - Verse pin/unpin (click handler)
   - Pan/zoom changes (debounced, use replaceState)
   - Overlay params (trop selection, category filter, search query)

2. **On page load:**
   - Parse URL state with `parseUrlState()`
   - Restore overlay, verse, zoom, pan, and overlay params

3. **For browser navigation:**
   - Subscribe to popstate via `subscribeToHashChange()`
   - Restore state when user hits back/forward

## Current behavior
- Copy Link button works but copies base URL with empty hash
- Interacting with app doesn't change URL at all

comments.author: danyel
comments.text:
## Design

### UI Structure
- Centered modal overlay (~500px wide) with semi-transparent backdrop
- Tab bar at top: [Overview] [Controls] [Overlays] with × close button (top right)
- Backdrop click or × closes modal
- When closed, (?) button appears in controls panel to reopen

### Behavior
- First visit: modal opens automatically
- Return visits: modal stays closed, (?) available
- localStorage keys:
  - torahMap.helpSeen - tracks if user has dismissed modal
  - torahMap.helpTab - remembers last viewed tab

### Tab Content

**Overview:**
- App title
- 1-2 sentence description of purpose
- Brief mention of Torah → Nevi'im → Ketuvim sections

**Controls:**
- Mouse wheel → Zoom
- Click + drag → Pan  
- Hover → Preview verse
- Click verse → Pin details
- Click pinned → Unpin

**Overlays:**
- List of overlays with short descriptions
- Extensible for tm-z25 to add per-overlay details

### Implementation
- New file: src/help.ts
- Changes to: index.html (styles), src/main.ts (integration)
